heading: The Main Features Of Our Taxi App Development Services

items.title: Passenger Profile
items.text: Every user or passenger get to create their own profile complete with their personal contact details.

items.title: Ride Now
items.text: Users can book a cab for immediate use from their real-time location with the ride now option.

items.title: Schedule Ride
items.text: For those unearthly cab rides, users can book a cab for a later time that is most convenient for them.

items.title: Book For Others
items.text: Users can book cabs using the app for someone else and send the ride details to them directly from the app.

items.title: Vehicle Selection
items.text: Users can choose a cab of their that best fits their time, size, and ride distance requirements.

items.title: Real-Time ETA
items.text: The app can highlight the real-time ETA of the ride to the user’s location accurately.

items.title: Fare Estimates
items.text: Inform users an estimated fare they have to pay for the ride once they reach their selected destination.

items.title: Driver Tracking
items.text: GPS-driven vehicle tracking that highlights the accurate location and the movement of the cab towards user location.

items.title: Multiple Payment Options
items.text: Passengers can pay using a variety of payment modes including cash, in-built digital wallet or cards.

items.title: Notification Alerts
items.text: Notification for every successful cab booking, the arrival of a cab, ride cancellation, ride completion, offer alerts and so on.

items.title: Preferred Driver
items.text: User populated star ratings and review system that will allow new passengers to select high-rated drivers.

items.title: SOS Button
items.text: When any unexpected mishaps happen, customers can use the SOS button to reach out for emergency support.

items.title: Promo Codes
items.text: Entice users to use the app regularly with loyalty schemes attached to promo codes, discounts, etc.

items.title: Referral Rewards
items.text: Incentivize users to invite their near and dear to use the app with referral rewards in the form of free rides, promo codes, etc.

items.title: Cancel Booking
items.text: Users can cancel their bookings easily from the same screen where the ride was booked along with appropriate reasons.

items.title: Contact Driver
items.text: Users can reach out to through phone call to the cab driver assigned to them straight from the app.

items.title: Ride Ratings
items.text: For every completed ride, the user can leave a star rating as well as text review of the ride experience.

items.title: Trip History
items.text: A complete history of all the completed rides along with data in timestamps can be seen the user profile section.

items.title: Favorite Location
items.text: A user can mark frequently visited locations as favorites. It helps save time when the booking has to be done repetitively.

items.title: Multilingual Support
items.text: Users can toggle between multiple languages to use the app effortlessly on a language of their choice.

items.title: Help & Support
items.text: For any queries that the user cannot find a solution to, there help & support section can be added to resolve their queries.

items.title: Invite Friends
items.text: Increase user base of the app by inducing existing users to invite their friends through social media, email or referral code.

items.title: Easy Registration
items.text: A simple and hassle-free process for drivers to easily register their vehicles or driver services with the app.

items.title: Select Availability
items.text: Drivers can toggle between their working hours and break hours using available and unavailable options.

items.title: Real Time Requests
items.text: All ride requests are populated on a real-time basis and forwarded to nearby drivers tracked using GPS.

items.title: Accept/Reject
items.text: Drivers can choose to accept or reject a ride depending on their availability or interest in taking the ride.

items.title: Trip Information
items.text: The driver gets complete trip information like passenger pickup location, drop location and estimated fare for the ride.

items.title: Navigation
items.text: GPS-enabled in-built navigation to guide the driver to the passenger drop location through the shortest and quickest route possible.

items.title: Cancel Booking
items.text: Not all bookings get through the first time. The driver can use the option to cancel a confirmed booking, if required.

items.title: Contact Passenger
items.text: Cab drivers can contact passengers straight from the app when they arrive at the destination or to intimate ETA.

items.title: Start/End Trip
items.text: Once the passenger is picked up the driver can start the end trip using OTP or swipe gestures on the app screen.

items.title: Trip Summary
items.text: A comprehensive trip summary comprising of information like a pickup, drop location, final fare, customer details, etc.

items.title: Track Earnings
items.text: The driver can track the entire earnings on a daily, weekly or monthly basis from the app screen.

items.title: Driver Dashboard
items.text: From completed trips to ongoing trips and earnings, the driver can see all vital info on a single screen.

items.title: Rate Customer
items.text: Drivers can also rate the passengers depending on the trip experience with star rating & reviews.

items.title: SOS Contacts
items.text: When things go wrong unexpectedly, the driver can reach out to admin or other emergency support teams.

items.title: My Destination
items.text: Drivers can set specific locations where they desire to get more rides from.

items.title: Upcoming Rides
items.text: Drivers can track numbers of upcoming rides scheduled from the dashboard as well as the earning from the rides.

items.title: Payment Management
items.text: The driver can receive payment in cash or in the wallet, payment can be transferred to the bank any point of time.

items.title: Trip History
items.text: The driver can see a complete list of timestamped view of trips and the earnings thereon using the trip history.

items.title: Support
items.text: The driver can reach to a service provider for any conflict or assistance.

items.title: Secure Login
items.text: SSO or email based secure login system for the admin to log into the panel.

items.title: Admin Dashboard
items.text: An all information compromising control centre exclusive for the admin.

items.title: Track Drivers
items.text: The admin can have a bird’s eye view of all drivers and their current location.

items.title: Manage Drivers
items.text: The admin has the user privileges to add, edit or remove drivers from time to time.

items.title: Manage Customers
items.text: Similar to drivers, the admin can also add, edit or remove customers from using the app.

items.title: Manage Dispatchers
items.text: The admin can add dispatch manager to handle operations and dispatches for a particular region and services.

items.title: Manage Vehicles
items.text: Admin can monitor the vehicle inventory and assign drivers to them for effective usage.

items.title: Manage Categories
items.text: Dispatch manager and Admin can add and update different car categories, location wise or by services demand.

items.title: Manage Tariffs
items.text: The admin can configure custom pricing or set up dynamic pricing that varies with volume and demand.

items.title: Reporting & Analytics
items.text: Know how users are booking rides, the most frequented routes, peak hours and much more with detailed reporting & analytics.

items.title: Dispatcher Panel
items.text: Dispatch managers get access to this panel to handle and deploy drives as per the demand.

items.title: Manual Bookings
items.text: For bookings that do not get done through the app, the admin can always raise manual bookings.

items.title: Heat Map
items.text: Admin has the access to monitor the demand for taxi and can accordingly deploy drivers in the regions.

items.title: Manage Refunds
items.text: Keep track of refunds that are to be initiated or to be transferred to users after verification.

items.title: SMS Alerts Settings
items.text: The admin can control the frequency of SMS alerts and when they should be sent to users.

items.title: Ride Later Settings
items.text: Configure how early users can schedule rides and what kind of cabs are available for scheduled bookings.

items.title: Country/Currency Settings
items.text: Multilingual and multi-currency support to help the app work appropriately for users from across the globe.

items.title: Send App Notifications
items.text: Configure what kind of push notifications can be sent, how frequently they can be sent to users from the admin panel.

items.title: Payment Integration
items.text: Integrate the app with payment integrations for cards, online banking and digital wallets.
